headline: Trilegal acts on establishment of  dedicated separately managed account for Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank
sum: Trilegal advised One Planet Partners in relation to the establishment of a dedicated Separately Managed Account (SMA) for Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Japan (SMTB), to be managed by One Planet Partners. Trilegal acted as transaction…
detail: Trilegal advised One Planet Partners in relation to the establishment of a dedicated Separately Managed Account (SMA) for Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Japan (SMTB), to be managed by One Planet Partners. Trilegal acted as transaction counsel, undertaking drafting of all necessary fund documents, negotiations and closing. The transaction was led by Pallabi Ghosal (Partner) and Ananya Sonthalia (Partner), with support from Saad Khan (Senior Associate), Associates Monika Saxena, Tejas Kandalgaonkar, Suhani Gadhve, Santoshi Shritha Pyda, Praneeth Sricharan and Ashima Joshi.
